name: Albashi
description: Albashi is a payroll agent on Celo that pays freelancers in naira (cNGN). The owner signs a payslip: who gets paid, how much cNGN each, the most USD₮ to spend, the lowest naira rate accepted, and a deadline. The agent acts from the owner's Altana wallet under a session whose only permitted call is PayRun.run on 0xfa8d963525d5F28427B897A0C761C744A43e59Af. PayRun fills a Textile FX quote, checks the rate it got against the signed floor, and pays exactly the signed lines; a payslip the owner did not sign is refused. Every transaction the agent sends carries the attribution tag celo_3f5cac8c49f6. Not audited.
